issue_title: Release preflight sensor: hard-fail closing-keyword titles on partial ships (L-013/L-025)
problem_statement:
Release preflight sensor: hard-fail closing-keyword titles on partial ships (L-013/L-025)

## Problem
Multi-slice issues keep auto-closing on partial PR merges. The guide (release playbook prose) forbids close/fix/resolve keywords near #N for partials, but agents still default to `fix(#N):` titles (L-025, chatterbuilt #115) and GitHub's linker ignores negations (L-013, chatterbuilt #28 closed four separate times). Issue #4 tracked this and was closed, but no sensor landed: `playbooks/release.md` contains no `closingIssuesReferences` check and no script enforces it.

## Proposed sensor
A release-preflight step (script `scripts/release-preflight.sh` or a block in the release playbook that shells out) that hard-fails the merge when BOTH:
1. The PR is marked partial / Related-only (body contains `Related: #N` without Closes/Fixes/Resolves, or an explicit `partial` marker), AND
2. `gh pr view N --json closingIssuesReferences` is non-empty, OR the squash/PR title matches `(?i)\b(fix|close|resolve|closes|fixes|resolves)\s*\(?#\d+`.

On failure: instruct retitle (`feat(scope): ... (related #N)`) and/or unlink via the Development sidebar before merge. Keep the existing recovery path (reopen + residual comment) for anything that slips through.

## Acceptance criteria
- Running preflight on a Related-only PR with a `fix(#N):` title exits non-zero with the exact remediation.
- Release playbook references the sensor as a required pre-merge step.
- Full-close PRs (genuine `Closes #N`) pass untouched.

Refs: L-013, L-025 in memory/LESSONS.md; supersedes closed #4. Guides only work if every fresh context reads and obeys them — this one has enough recurrences to earn a sensor.
